package fake

import (
	"net"
	"net/http"
)

// Rehandle serves a server built elsewhere through an interface, so no
// listed method is named; the server value itself is what the gate sees.
func Rehandle(get func() *http.Server, ln net.Listener) error {
	var s interface{ Serve(net.Listener) error } = get()
	return s.Serve(ln)
}
